implementation success* Lead stakeholder engagement and change management initiatives to ensure organizational readiness and sustainable adoptionWhat You Bring* Bachelor's or Master's degree in transformation programs* Strong expertise in Record-to-Report, Project Controlling, Product Costing, Manufacturing Controlling, and Financial Closing* Solid understanding of Engineer-to-Order (ETO) business processes and end-to-end value flows across project execution and manufacturing* Excellent stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and leadership skills with experience aligning global cross-functional teams* Fluency in German and English, enabling effective collaboration in an international environmentAbout the TeamOur Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/x) Biology (Life Sciences) (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: We are looking to support our rapidly growing team as soon as possible: Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/x) Biology (Life Sciences) for Preclinical ImagingRadiochemie TV-L: 38,5 h/week (100%) 1-year fixed-term contract under the WissZeitVG; plus a 1-year extension for a third-party funded projectYour salary will be based on TV-LYour tasks• Planning, conducting and analyzing the biological evaluation of newly developed PET and SPECT radiotracers• Contributing to the establishment, optimization anddocumentation of biological test systems and preclinical evaluation protocols• Performing in vitro studies, including stability, binding and cellular uptake assays as well as studies using models of the blood-brain-barrier• Preclinical evaluation of tracer candidates in suitable in vivo models, including support of small-animal imaging studies• Performing and analyzing ex vivo studies, e.g., autoradiography, biodistribution studies and complementary tissue analyses• Quantitative analysis of biological and imaging data andinterpretation of results in close interaction with the other project partners• Evaluation, documentation, and scientific presentation of experimental results in project reports, publications, and presentationsYour profile• Completed university degree and Ph.D. in biology, life sciences, neuroscience, biochemistry, pharmacy or a related field• Experience in preclinical imaging (e.g. small animal PET, SPECT, MRI, CT)• Experience with animal models and experimental animal work is advantageous (FELASA-B or EU functions A, C, D)• Experience with cell culture, in vitro assays, autoradiography, ex vivo analyses and BBB models is desirable• Interest in radiopharmaceutical tracer development, molecular imaging and translational research• Willingness to work with unsealed radioactive substances and to become familiar with radiation protection-related workflows• Willingness to conduct biological and preclinical experiments within an interdisciplinary team• Good written and spoken English skills• Structured, independent and conscientious working style• Ability to work in a team, strong communication skills and interest in interdisciplinary collaboration between chemistry, radiochemistry, biology, medicine and imagingOur offer• Everything but ordinary: You can expect a secure job in a challenging, innovative environment – including company pension schemes and regular working hours without business trips.• Work-life balance: Whether full-time or part-time, with or without children – with numerous support options, we will find the right path together.• Team spirit in R(h)ine culture: You will be warmly welcomed by an interdisciplinary team that values mutual respect and helpfulness.• Strong perspectives: We offer extensive training opportunities – so you can continuously grow and set new goals.Your future with usWe are one of the leading university hospitals in Germany and network research, teaching and health care at the highest level. That's why many things are a lot bigger for us: the spectrum of exciting development opportunities. The limitless openness with which specialists from all over the world work together here. Or our commitment as an employer to support all employees as best we can in reconciling their job with their goals and life situations.This is the University Hospital of Cologne: Everything but ordinary.Your future in detailThe Institute of Radiochemistry and Experimental Molecular Imaging (IREMB) is seeking a postdoctoral researcher for a translational research project in the field of radiopharmaceutical tracer development and molecular imaging. The postdoc position will initially be embedded for one year in the internationally funded IMAGESTRO project. There is an option of extension for another year. The focus of the work will be on the biological validation of newly developed PET or SPECT radiotracers.The IMAGESTRO project aims to develop novel 18F-labeled PET tracers for the non-invasive imaging of estrogen receptors in the brain, to characterize them preclinically, and to translate them into human applications. The project focuses on the organic synthesis of suitable precursor and reference compounds, the development and optimizationof radiofluorination strategies, and the comprehensive analytical and preclinical characterization of the resulting radiotracers. The work will be carried out in close cooperation between the University Hospital Cologne and Forschungszentrum Jülich and offers an interdisciplinary research environment at the interface of organic chemistry, radiochemistry, radiopharmacy, molecular imaging, biology and neuroscience.Applications from female candidates are expressly welcome and will be given priority in the event of equal suitability, competence and professional performance. People with disabilities are welcome to apply and will be treated preferentially in the event of equal suitability and qualification. The position is suitable for staffing with part-time employees.ContactUniv.-Prof. Dr. Bernd NeumaierTel.: +49 221 478-86807Universitätsklinikum Köln AöRGeschäftsbereich PersonalKerpener Str. 6250937 KölnUniklinik Köln Karriere Application deadline: 13.09.2026Job-ID: 4bxxe1uxWe look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you!

jobs.occupation: (Senior) HEOR Manager (Produktmanager/in)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: OUR COMPANYAt Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.The PositionAre you passionate about innovation, finding cutting-edge solutions and creating value where it matters, around the globe? At the BI global Inflammation team, we strive to deliver innovative Therapeutic and patient centric solutions by putting the patient in the center of everything we do. We foster innovative thinking as well as an agile and collaborative way of working to advance our novel programs and capabilities in Therapeutic Area Inflammation.The Global TA Inflammation, (Senior) HEOR  Manager, brings technical expertise, driving Outcomes Research (HEOR) and Patient Related Outcomes fostering our patient centric drive. His/she will support the TA Market Access Head by providing oversight, direction, and functional support on HEOR & PRO & Access projects. He/she will be working closely with Value and Evidence Networks within our Global Business Unit and with external stakeholders.Tasks & responsibilities- In your new role, you develop and execute on health economics outcomes research (HEOR) & PRO strategies, demonstrating the medical and economic payer-relevant needs to optimize value of BI products.- In this function, you generate evidence that secures optimal market access, successful HTA assessments, optimal pricing, reimbursement and formulary listing for BI products on a global scale.- Additionally, you ensure insights to further inform development of the Target Product Profile (TPP), clinical development plan of our pipeline compounds.- In consideration of regulatory body request and trial development, pre and post launch you will ensure relevant and new patient-reported outcome (PRO) measurement strategies to ensure that the patient perspective is captured in our clinical trial program and interact with regulatory authorities, closely collaborating with other functions.- Besides, you ensure efficient and timely development of key HEOR deliverables (i.e. payer value stories, payer engagement tools, GVDs, economic models, retrospective database analyses, indirect comparisons, real world evidence data) for assigned BI products.- Finally, yet importantly, you develop and maintain relevant partnerships with payers, academic research institutions, contract research organizations and other HEOR thought leaders in order to optimize the impact of HEOR & PRO research.Additional responsibilities as Senior Manager:- You will define long-term global development strategies for the assets, in close collaboration with the global Marketing and global Medical counterparts, to ensure optimal patient access.- In addition, you will draft long-term publication strategies, considering the long-term global market development.Requirements- Graduate degree, preferably PhD in health economics, Medicine (MD), public health, pharmacy, focusing on Health Technology Assessment, PRO, Pharmacy, Medicine, Public Health- Several years of pharma industry experience, with positions in areas of relevance for HEOR, PRO consulting or payer authorities- Multiple years of direct experience undertaking Health Technology Assessments (HTA) & PRO including Evaluations for Regulatory and health authority interventions of pharmaceutical products- Conducting or being part of a team working on non-interventional studies and RWE programs- Demonstrated experience of successful regulatory, reimbursement negotiations for launching new products in key markets- Proven track record of delivering value demonstration materials that resulted in timely patient access and adoption- Proven ability in appraising clinical evidence (both RCTs and operational evidence)- Profound knowledge and expertise to formulating COA strategies including validation methods, administration of measures and statistical analyses of COA data- Excellent communication and influencing skill both in internal and external contextAdditional requirements as Senior HEOR Manager:- Long-term pharma industry experience, with positions in the areas of health economics, pricing & reimbursement, consulting, or payer authorities- Several years of exposure to international business on a day-to-day basis- Strong track record in value generation, demonstration and/or communication- Highly experienced in conducting health economics/outcomes research across multiple specialty disciplines (e.g. patient reported outcomes, health economic modelling, real world data generation)For employees with a current contract of limited duration, legal / labor agreement requirements for contract extension will be considered.With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com﻿Ready to contact us?If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team,Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or per mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.comPlease submit your application documents in English.

profileRecruitment requirement- A PhD in the subject areas of Materials science, Electrochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or similar.Required knowledge and personal skills- Strong with aqueous batteries, metal-anode batteries, or electrolyte development.- Experience with materials characterization techniques, such as microscopy, X-ray methods.- Experience with automated experimentation, robotics, data science, or machine learning is advantageous.Reach out with your CV and motivation letter expressing your interest and experience in the proposed topic.
